input: Why did my parent not invite me to their wedding?
output: It is possible that your parent did not invite you to their wedding for a variety of reasons. It could be that they did not want to burden you with the planning or expense of the event, or they may not have had the time or resources to include you. Additionally, it could be that they did not feel comfortable having you attend due to your age or relationship with them. It is important to remember that your parent may have had their own reasons for not inviting you, and it is not your place to judge their choices. If you feel neglected or upset about not being invited, it is best to talk to them about it and express your feelings in a non-accusatory way.,
